text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган has successfully made
her
debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite how much she admired the
Twinkle
Series, she finds the races she's
competed in so
far to be more boring
than expected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The difference between her dreams and
reality
has her in a tailspin. But she's still
at the debut
level. If she's able to run in
more races, I'm sure
she'll change her
mind...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
